title: Lauda (song)
extract: The lauda or lauda spirituale was the most important form of vernacular sacred song in Italy in the late medieval era and the Renaissance. Laude remained popular into the nineteenth century. The lauda was often associated with Christmas, and so is in part equivalent to the English carol, French noel, Spanish villancico, and like these genres occupies a middle ground between folk and learned lyrics.
